summary: Intermap Technologies filed a Form 6-K on November 5, 2026, attaching a Canadian Form 51-102F3 Material Change Report dated the same day. The filing discloses that on November 2, 2026 the board appointed Terrence Michael Ryan as an independent director, replacing Philippe Frappier, who resigned from the board and was appointed a board observer and advisor. No transaction, price, stake or strategic process is disclosed; the item is an ordinary board composition update rather than a forced or abrupt CEO/CFO departure. No advisor, premium, regulatory clock or deal mechanics apply; there is no risk-arb angle to watch.
